config.title: TAG DER CLUBKULTUR Berlin 2026 - FAQ
config.subtitle: How to choose one real event from Berlin club culture week.

items.q: When is TAG DER CLUBKULTUR Berlin 2026?
items.a: The 2026 festival runs from 3 to 11 October. It is the seventh edition and uses the theme STAY CORE.

items.q: Is TAG DER CLUBKULTUR only about late club nights?
items.a: No. The official programme includes club nights, open-airs, concerts, performances, exhibitions, workshops, talks and film screenings. Check the individual listing for the actual format.

items.q: Do I need a ticket for TAG DER CLUBKULTUR?
items.a: It depends on the individual event. Check the live listing for tickets, reservations, guest-list rules, access conditions and venue updates.

items.q: Does the festival make Berlin club entry easier?
items.a: Do not assume that it does. Each venue can have its own entry, capacity, age, bag and accessibility rules.

items.q: What is the easiest way to plan a TAG DER CLUBKULTUR evening?
items.a: Choose one format, save one first-choice event and one nearby backup, then use a live route planner for the confirmed venue. Avoid trying to rescue a night with several distant venues.
